Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you loud and clear tonight.

Mars is firing a tense square to your ruling planet while sextile your solar heart in the 1st House, shaking your 7th House of partnerships and your 10th House of career all at once.

Love: Your fiery Mars energy is colliding with a relationship's need for independence, so avoid pushing too hard; instead, give your partner space to lead their own 5th House creativity. Your temper may flare, but choose tenderness.

Money: That same square activates your 2nd House of finances, meaning sudden spending on bold ventures could backfire, but a small calculated risk in your 8th House shared resources brings relief. Protect your purse.

Warning or blessing: Avoid burning bridges tonight, but an unexpected financial gift from an unexpected source just arrives.

Follow for tomorrow's reading, Aries.
